snippet.title: Odysseon Chapter 3 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Odysseon is a JRPG style game with an emphasis on characters and story telling. Explore a dreary world populated by strange people and bizarre creatures, pieced together alongside a soundtrack of long forgotten vintage production music.

Odysseon is a work in progress game, and I dabble in a lot of other projects in my spare time so please be patient. You can follow me on Bluesky for live updates @hawtkoffee.bsky.social

You can download the game here.
https://hawf.itch.io/odysseon/devlog/1377334/chapter-3-released

Song: Cat Food - King Crimson
